ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering the Feeding Our Future Fraud Scheme
ideas.description: This story would investigate the Feeding Our Future fraud scheme, including the individuals and organizations involved, and the methods used to carry out the scheme.
questions: How did the fraud scheme work?
ideas.insight: The Feeding Our Future fraud scheme is a complex and large-scale case that requires a thorough investigation to uncover the truth. By following the money and analyzing financial records, we can identify the individuals and organizations involved and shed light on the methods used to carry out the scheme.
